declarations.name: AuiContextMenu
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Context Menu, on the target element: `
...
`. The target keeps its Angular-managed children; the menu popup is appended to the enclosing modal dialog or .

inputs.name: auiContextMenu
inputs.description: Menu items (the Menu item model: action with optional submenu items, checkbox, radio, separator, group). Ids are unique across the whole tree. An empty array is allowed.

inputs.name: contextMenuLabel
inputs.description: aria-label of the menu. Default: localized 'Context menu'. Must be non-empty when set.

inputs.name: contextMenuDisabled
inputs.description: While true, right-click and the keyboard keys keep the browser's native behavior and open() is still possible; setting it closes an open menu.

inputs.name: closeOnSelect
inputs.description: Close after activating a checkbox or radio item. Action items always close the menu.

inputs.name: typeahead
inputs.description: Printable characters move focus to the next item whose label starts with them.

inputs.name: nativeModifier
inputs.description: 'shift': Shift+right-click is left to the browser's native menu. 'none': every right-click opens the component menu.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Logical alignment, submenu side, submenu arrow keys, and chevron mirroring.

inputs.name: renderItem
inputs.description: Custom item content as a function; or put `<ng-template auiItem let-item>` inside the host (since 0.9.0).

outputs.name: selected
outputs.description: Dispatched on the target when the user activates an enabled item. origin is the element the menu was opened for; checked is the new state for checkbox and radio items.

outputs.name: opened
outputs.description: Dispatched on the menu element after the top level opened.

outputs.name: closed
outputs.description: Dispatched on the menu element after all levels closed.

methods.name: open
methods.signature: open(point?: { x: number; y: number; } | undefined): void
methods.description: Open at client coordinates, or below the target.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Menu (the Menu engine) opened as a context menu at the pointer or at the focused element; roving focus with real DOM focus on items.

limitations: The target gets no ARIA attributes: nothing announces that a context menu exists. Add a visible or described hint (for example aria-describedby text such as 'Press Shift+F10 for actions') and provide every action elsewhere.

nativeModifier applies to pointer right-clicks only: inside an enabled target Shift+F10 and the ContextMenu key always open the component menu, so the native menu is not reachable from the keyboard there.
One item list per instance; vary items per origin with update({ items }) from a capture-phase contextmenu listener on the target.
The pointer anchor is fixed relative to the target's box; when the target itself is a scroll container, scrolling its content does not move the menu.
Keyboard-generated contextmenu events are recognized heuristically (button other than 2 at client point 0,0); browsers that report other coordinates open at that point instead of the focused element.
Popups are appended to the target's enclosing <dialog> or to <body> at construction; moving the target into or out of a dialog afterwards needs destroy() and create().
